title: The Cornerstone That Never Fails
story:
A builder once constructed two houses in the same village.

One was built quickly on soft ground.

The other took longer because the foundation was carefully set on solid rock.

At first, both houses looked beautiful.

But one day, heavy rains and strong winds came.

The house on soft ground began to crack.

It could not withstand the storm.

But the house built on rock remained firm.

The builder said,

“A strong foundation is more important than a fast beginning.”

In life, many things look stable at first.

Success.

People.

Plans.

But storms always come.

Only what is built on Christ remains secure.

He is the chosen cornerstone.

And those who trust in Him will never be shaken.
life_lesson: Only life built on Christ, the cornerstone, will remain unshaken.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for giving me Jesus as my cornerstone.

Help me to build my life on Him alone.

When storms come, keep me firm in Your truth.

Remove anything in my life that is not built on You.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What are you building your life on today?

Are there areas not grounded in Christ?

How can you strengthen your foundation in Him?
verse:
See, I lay a stone in Zion,
a chosen and precious cornerstone,
and the one who trusts in Him will never be put to shame.
